title: Signal: SQLite driver error text disclosed in a response
scope: One response body containing a SQLite driver error string or class name.
limitations: One response body. The check reads the message text; it does not read the database file and cannot tell whether the file is still on disk.

observation.body: Fatal error: Uncaught SQLite3::query(): Unable to prepare statement: 1, no such table: notes
sqlite3.OperationalError: unable to open database file
Our desktop build stores data locally with SQLite for offline use.

fpNotes: A documentation page that quotes the message is reported; a page that mentions SQLite as a product feature is not.
